title: ASVS participation classifier reply (persona-facing, one chapter cell, ADR-0034)
description: What the asvs-participation-classifier writes for one chapter cell: a classification of each listed candidate, nothing else. It does not choose chapters, controls, lanes or downstream work. The orchestrator derives ids, chapter, cell identity and hashes; do not write them. Checks in code: every listed candidate gets exactly one record; every citation resolves to a line of the pinned source snapshot; a record with a candidate_id names that candidate's file and a span inside its function.

candidate_id.description: The candidate_id exactly as listed in the cell input, or null for a function you found by reading that takes part in this chapter but was not listed.

symbol.description: Function or method name as the cell input or the code index names it.

file.description: Repository-relative path, exactly as listed (no root prefix).

role.description: implements: the function performs the chapter's security mechanism itself (e.g. opens files, encodes output, logs events). enforces: it checks or gates something the chapter requires (validation, authorization, limits). consumes: it relies on such a mechanism or passes chapter-relevant data to it. not_participating: the matched construct does not take part in this chapter's concern (cite the lines that show it).
